snippet.title: Pop! Pachinko Trailer
snippet.description:
Pop! Pachinko is a city pop-inspired pachinko roguelike where every ball can trigger massive chain reactions. Build busted combos, collect Chibi Pops, and chase the ultimate high score.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4437370/Pop_Pachinko/

Features
- Pachinko-inspired roguelike gameplay
- Build powerful elemental synergies
- Collect adorable Chibi Pops
- Unlock game-changing Charms
- Chase ever-higher scores
- Original city pop-inspired soundtrack

#pachinko #indiegame #roguelike #citypop #indiedev #steamgame
